description: Read the latest text matching a named sender or a named Messages conversation, including a group thread. Scope sender looks for incoming text from that contact. Scope conversation looks in that exact chat and includes both directions. Use this for the latest text by person or thread. Use find_messages instead for an explicit phrase with no named sender or chat.

params.name: scope
params.description: Whether the given name identifies the person who sent it or the Messages conversation.

params.name: name
params.description: The contact name or exact Messages chat or group name, as provided by the user.
